name: /death/lor/ation/
source:
Your Anima awakens in the paintings of the Bardo: the systems of the universe are united by the dance of the threads of destinies.

A step in the logic of history is a spiral to the knowledge of the Mystery of the Breath of the Universe.

Would you ReBorn?

[From [url=https://broken-curse-studios.itch.io/deathloration]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的阿尼玛在中阴画中苏醒：宇宙的系统通过命运之线的舞蹈而结合在一起。

历史逻辑的一步是对宇宙呼吸之谜知识的螺旋式上升。

你会重生吗？

[来自[url=https://broken-curse-studios.itch.io/deathloration]Itch.io[/url]]
